rules.expected: candidate-specific validation is documented Inspect candidate-specific OH normal-mode displacements, intensities, mapped atoms, declared scaling/anharmonic treatment and comparison with the measured bands. Candidate optimization alone does not establish spectral assignments.
supports hydration-induced reorganization beginning at n=3 within the stated isolated-cluster scope

reported and supported by candidate observables Use candidate-relative energies only within each hydration size; distinguish electronic E, E+ZPE and G(T,p). Compare the full n=1-5 structural evidence before inferring an onset within the finite explored set; A-series observations do not certify untested alternatives or global minima.

reported and supported by candidate observables Compare the supplied OH bands across all five sizes with explicit mode identity, matched and unmatched features, residuals and uncertainty. Existing hydroxide-stretch support cannot stand in for unassigned water stretches.
